claims.quote: For patients with HAP, we recommend a 7-day course of antimicrobial therapy (strong recommendation, very low-quality evidence).
claims.locator: XXII. What Is the Optimal Duration of Antibiotic Therapy for HAP (Non-VAP)? › Recommendation

claims.quote: For patients with VAP, we recommend a 7-day course of antimicrobial therapy rather than a longer duration (strong recommendation, moderate-quality evidence).
claims.locator: XXI. Should Patients With VAP Receive 7 Days or 8–15 Days of Antibiotic Therapy? › Recommendation
